content:
name: Draft Release

on:
    push:
        branches: [main]
    # pull_request_target instead of pull_request so the autolabeler gets a write-capable token on fork PRs; the plain pull_request token is read-only for forks, which made labeling fail with "Resource not accessible by integration". Safe because the auto_label job never checks out or executes PR code.
    pull_request_target:
        types: [opened, reopened, synchronize]

jobs:
    update_release_draft_tailwind_merge:
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        permissions:
            contents: write
            pull-requests: read
        steps:
            # Pinned from release-drafter/release-drafter@v7.3.0.
            - uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@c2e2804cc59f45f57076a99af580d0fedb697927
              with:
                  config-name: release-drafter-tailwind-merge.yml
                  token: ${{ github.token }}

    update_release_draft_vite:
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        permissions:
            contents: write
            pull-requests: read
        steps:
            # Pinned from release-drafter/release-drafter@v7.3.0.
            - uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@c2e2804cc59f45f57076a99af580d0fedb697927
              with:
                  config-name: release-drafter-vite.yml
                  token: ${{ github.token }}

    update_release_draft_next:
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        permissions:
            contents: write
            pull-requests: read
        steps:
            # Pinned from release-drafter/release-drafter@v7.3.0.
            - uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@c2e2804cc59f45f57076a99af580d0fedb697927
              with:
                  config-name: release-drafter-next.yml
                  token: ${{ github.token }}

    auto_label:
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        permissions:
            contents: read
            pull-requests: write
        steps:
            # Pinned from release-drafter/release-drafter@v7.3.0. The autolabeler section lives in the tailwind-merge config; labels are repo-wide, so it runs once.
            - uses: release-drafter/release-drafter/autolabeler@c2e2804cc59f45f57076a99af580d0fedb697927
              with:
                  config-name: release-drafter-tailwind-merge.yml
                  token: ${{ github.token }}
